metadata.title: Polycrisis Research Seed Graph
metadata.scope: Heterogeneous exploratory field map for polycrisis and interconnected global crises research.
metadata.construction_method: Manual first-stage seed graph derived primarily from the uploaded research program/design, with a small number of externally added representative publication/person anchors for graph connectivity. It is not a full bibliometric extraction.
metadata.recommended_next_step: Validate and expand nodes/edges using OpenAlex/Crossref/institutional websites; replace low-confidence citation and affiliation edges with sourced data.
metadata.centrality_note: Weighted degree and PageRank use edge weights as tie strength. Betweenness centrality uses inverse weight as distance, so stronger ties are shorter paths.

interpretive_notes: Polycrisis appears as a bridge concept rather than the only center; it links systemic risk, complexity, governance, and crisis-domain nodes.
Planetary boundaries/safe-and-just boundaries, resilience/SES, and sustainability transitions form dense clusters that are older and more institutionally anchored than explicit polycrisis discourse.

Methodological fragmentation is visible in separate modelling, governance, transition, and critical-theory method clusters; edges between them are often concept-mediated rather than institution-mediated.
Governance frameworks are connected but should not be read as direct causal influence without further evidence; the seed graph uses linked_to/contributes_to cautiously.
